description: Standalone Material 3 Expressive navigation bar and miniplayer redesign add-on for YouTube Music

patches.name: M3 Redesign addon
patches.description: Redesigns the miniplayer, navigation bar, and Now Playing screen into a customizable Material 3 Expressive layout with wave seekbar, rotating wavy search button, ambient glow, and dynamic album palette.

patches.name: Remove top black bar
patches.description: Removes the black status-bar gap above YouTube videos in portrait full screen (especially on tablets) when hiding the status bar, allowing true edge-to-edge playback.

patches.name: Scroll away home toolbar
patches.description: Makes the YouTube Home screen top toolbar act like the top of the page so it scrolls away cleanly with the feed instead of staying persistent or popping back mid-page.
